Preserve exact key/item identity, three-fragment goal and once-only acquisition, ownership and allowed checkpoint recovery. A Crown-specific authored object is not an invented SRD magic-item ability.
Preserve selected custom item semantics and availability as campaign policy. Do not relabel Antidote as Antitoxin, add SRD powers or remove existing content during writing.

Map actual created copies/batches, source owner, portions, location, lifetime and exact ending/consumption without replay. Never replace transient magical output with a permanent tradeable catalog item.
Reuse the existing Pact of the Tome/Wizard rules; bind preparation/focus permission to the correct exact book and source. Book of Shadows is neither ordinary Book nor Wizard Spellbook.

Reuse the complete authoring owner for Pact of Blade, Rock Gnome or Tinker task. Persist actual object choices, actor/source, activation budget and independent timers/endings; no feature-ID dispatch or newly invented object powers.
